tool_plan_template.description: Select stocks forming VCP and close to breakout with favorable fundamentals.
tool_plan_template.template:
SELECT
  v.symbol,
  v.company_name,
  v.price,
  v.vcp_score,
  s.enhanced_fund_score,
  s.trading_signal
FROM
  scores.stage2_vcp_picks v
JOIN
  scores.stage_snapshots s ON v.symbol = s.symbol
WHERE
  v.snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM scores.stage2_vcp_picks) AND
  s.snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM scores.stage_snapshots) AND
  s.stage = 'STAGE_2' AND
  s.trading_signal IN ('BUY', 'STRONG_BUY')
ORDER BY
  v.vcp_score DESC
LIMIT 50;
